rationale.dunbi: Clear weighted head bulb at upper-right; canonical 起笔 press.
rationale.hudu: Gentle concave-down arc — natural, not robotic-straight, not over-curled.
rationale.taper: Smooth gradient from heavy head (18) through shaft (~14→11) to fine tail point (3). First stroke with a real tip taper — established the pattern for 提 and tail-tapered compounds.
rationale.proportion: Diagonal ~430 px, head at ~+150,+200, tail at -180,-180 — balanced.
rationale.overall: Reads as canonical 楷书 斜撇. Drawer used self-preview budget (iter 1→2) to bump head bulb from 17 to 18 and extend taper range — visible improvement.
